pricing.Definition

Creates a definition of information about the specific Pricing data.

Available as lseg.data.content.pricing.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(
    universe: StrStrings,
    fields: OptStrStrs = None,
    service: OptStr = None,
    api: OptStr = None,
    extended_params: ExtendedParams = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
universe StrStrings Yes Single instrument or list of instruments.
fields OptStrStrs No None Single field or list of fields to return.
service OptStr No None Name of the streaming service publishing the instruments.
api OptStr No None Specifies the data source for the further retrieval of data.
extended_params ExtendedParams No None Specifies the parameters that will be merged with the request.

Methods

get_data

Sends a request to the Data Platform to retrieve the predefined data.

get_data(session: Session | None = None) -> T

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.

Returns

Response

Returns as the result of successful response from Data Platform.

get_data_async

Sends an asynchronous request to the Data Platform to retrieve the predefined data.

async get_data_async(
    session: Session | None = None,
    on_response: Callable | None = None,
    closure: str | None = None,
) -> T

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.
on_response Callable | None No None Callable function to process the retrieved data.
closure str | None No None Closure parameters that will be returned with the response.

Returns

Response

Returns as the result of successful response from Data Platform.

get_stream

Creates and returns the pricing stream that allows you to get streaming data for previously defined instruments.

get_stream(session: Session = None) -> Stream

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.

Returns

pricing.Stream

Example

from lseg.data.content import pricing
definition = pricing.Definition("IBM")
stream = definition.get_stream()
stream.open()

Example

from lseg.data.content import pricing
definition = pricing.Definition("EUR=")
response = definition.get_data()
